concept: Genuine curiosity about people who see the world differently than you do
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.case_study: A realistic conversation scenario with someone holding a genuinely different perspective on a low-stakes topic
exercise.reflection_prompt: What would you need to ask to actually understand their view, rather than just wait to respond?
exercise.practice: Adult drafts three genuine questions they'd ask to understand rather than to counter

assessment.success_marker: adult's drafted questions are genuinely exploratory rather than rhetorical or leading
